clues: Otis stood somewhere to the left of Jonah.
Gus stood directly to the left of Otis, with nobody in between.
Lena's spot was somewhere to the right of Hattie's.
Counting from the left, Hattie was either second or fourth.
hints: Look at the first column. Who could possibly stand at the far left of the photo?
Read down the columns too. Comparisons rule out the ends: check each clue for who it keeps off the far left.
Clues 1 to 4 keep Jonah, Otis, Lena and Hattie off the far left. So Gus stood first, and by clue 2, Otis stood second.

solution.key_idea: Clues 1 to 4 keep everyone but Gus off the far left, so Gus was first, and Otis, by clue 2, second.
steps: Clue 4 keeps Hattie off the first spot. Otis, Jonah and Lena each stood right of someone (clues 2, 1 and 3), so none was first.
So Gus stood first, at the far left.
By clue 2, Otis stood directly right of Gus, so Otis was second, and Hattie was fourth (clue 4).
By clue 3, Lena stood to the right of Hattie, so Lena was fifth.
That leaves the third spot for Jonah, right of Otis, just as clue 1 requires.
solution.epilogue: The caption read Gus, Otis, Jonah, Hattie and Lena, left to right. Teddy blamed the glance at the lantern room on a passing gull, and Ada tucked a print in her drawer.

tip: Anyone who stands to the right of somebody can never stand at the far left.
